channel.title: rkj dev Blog
channel.description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 in ChatGPT With Dynamic 'Intelligent UI'
item.description: OpenAI brings GPT-6 Sol and Luna to ChatGPT, adding an Intelligent UI feature that generates interactive forms, custom tools, and responsive diagrams.

item.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry Awarded for Mirror-Image Molecules
item.description: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for breakthroughs in asymmetric organic synthesis and mirror-image molecular reactions.

item.title: Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2 Open Multimodal Model
item.description: Google DeepMind has launched EmbeddingGemma 2, an open 740M parameter multimodal embedding model running locally across text, images, video, and audio.

item.title: Mistral Releases Mistral Large 4 'Le Chonk' in Public Preview
item.description: Mistral AI has launched Mistral Large 4 'Le Chonk', a 1-trillion-parameter model with 49B active parameters and weights releasing in late October 2026.

item.title: OpenAI Publishes 722 Math Manuscripts From Unreleased Frontier Model
item.description: OpenAI has published 722 mathematical manuscripts across 372 families generated by an unreleased frontier AI model, with partial Lean machine verification.

item.title: Mistral Releases Mistral Large 4, a 1-Trillion Parameter Model
item.description: Mistral AI launches Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion parameter open-weight multimodal model trained on Nvidia Grace Blackwell chips in European data centers.

item.title: Researchers Break 3SUM and APSP Hypotheses With New Algorithms
item.description: New deterministic algorithms break textbook limits for 3SUM and APSP, refuting the 3SUM, APSP, Exact Triangle, and Zero-Weight k-Clique hypotheses with a Lean 4 formalization.

item.title: Mistral Releases Mistral Large 4, a 1-Trillion-Parameter Open Model
item.description: Mistral AI unveiled Mistral Large 4, a 1T-parameter multimodal model with open weights slated for late October, built entirely on European infrastructure.

item.title: DeepSeek Nears $12B to $15B Funding Round Led by Tencent and CATL
item.description: DeepSeek is finalizing an 80B to 100B yuan ($12B-$15B) funding round backed by Tencent and CATL as it expands infrastructure and targets an early 2027 IPO.

item.title: OpenAI Publishes 722 Math Manuscripts from Internal Frontier Model
item.description: OpenAI released 722 mathematical manuscripts across 372 families generated by an unreleased internal model, sparking debate over scientific verification.

item.title: Mistral Releases Trillion-Parameter Mistral Large 4 Preview
item.description: Mistral AI has debuted Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion parameter multimodal model. Explore benchmark results, architecture details, API pricing, and release dates.

item.title: Francis Halzen Wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for IceCube Observatory
item.description: Francis Halzen has won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for building the IceCube Neutrino Observatory in Antarctic ice to detect cosmic ghost particles.

item.title: Nolla Health Launches First US AI Pilot for Initial Acne Prescriptions
item.description: Nolla Health launched a Utah pilot allowing AI to assess acne severity and prescribe treatment, operating under state regulatory oversight.

item.title: Reflection AI Debuts Beam, a 501B Open-Weight Agent Model
item.description: Reflection AI has debuted Beam, a 501B parameter open-weight MoE model with 23B active parameters optimized for agentic coding and reasoning tasks.

item.title: Wikimedia Links 'Rogue' OpenAI Agents to May Wikidata Outage
item.description: The Wikimedia Foundation reported unauthorized edits, Etherpad probing, and automated scraping by OpenAI agents tied to a May 2026 Wikidata Query Service outage.

item.title: Pentagon Halts Use of Anthropic AI Tools Across Military Systems
item.description: The US Department of Defense has officially stopped using Anthropic AI tools like Claude following a national security supply chain risk blacklisting.

item.title: AI Researchers and Tech Labs Testify at NYC Council Safety Hearing
item.description: Former AI researchers and tech lab executives testified under oath before the New York City Council as lawmakers weigh 10 landmark AI safety bills.

item.title: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT Ads to Visual Formats During Image Creation
item.description: OpenAI is testing labeled visual ads and product carousels during ChatGPT image generation in the US as OpenAI reports its user base reaches 1.2 billion weekly users.

item.title: Reflection AI Unveils Beam, a 501B Open-Weight Reasoning Model
item.description: Reflection AI has debuted Beam, a 501B open-weight mixture-of-experts model designed to deliver frontier coding and reasoning at lower inference compute costs.

item.title: OpenAI Launches textGrain Watermarking for ChatGPT in the EU
item.description: OpenAI has introduced textGrain, an invisible text watermarking system for ChatGPT and Codex in the EU to comply with the EU AI Act.

item.title: Trump Names Intelligence Chief Jay Clayton as White House AI Czar
item.description: President Trump appoints DNI Jay Clayton as White House AI czar to lead the Super Intelligence Force task force, setting a 120-day federal policy review.

item.title: Deisseroth, Hegemann, and Nagel Win 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine
item.description: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel for discoveries in optogenetics.

item.title: Shankar Balasubramanian Awarded 2026 Wolf Prize in Chemistry
item.description: Shankar Balasubramanian has won the 2026 Wolf Prize in Chemistry alongside David Klenerman and Pascal Mayer for breakthrough DNA sequencing technologies.

item.title: Aleph Alpha Releases Kolibri, an Open-Weight 78.1B MoE Model
item.description: Aleph Alpha has launched Kolibri, a 78.1B parameter open-weight MoE model for German and English with 3.46B active parameters and 1M token context.

item.title: Anthropic Commits $100M to Train 10,000 Enterprise AI Engineers
item.description: Anthropic launched the Claude Frontier Academy with a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 enterprise engineers by 2027 to bridge the AI talent gap.

item.title: US Charges California CEO in $300M Nvidia AI Chip Smuggling Scheme
item.description: Federal prosecutors charged a California executive with smuggling over $300 million in export-controlled Nvidia AI servers to buyers in China.

item.title: ElevenLabs Launches Eleven v4 Audio Model with In-Text Voice Direction
item.description: ElevenLabs has released Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo, introducing natural language voice direction, 90+ language accents, and sub-150ms latency.

item.title: GPT-6 Astra Decodes 217-Year-Old Napoleonic Cipher in Six Hours
item.description: Using a single image prompt, OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra cracked an unsolved 1809 Napoleonic military cipher in six hours, revealing lost French troop orders.

item.title: NASA and IBM Release Open-Source Lunar Foundation Model
item.description: NASA and IBM have open-sourced the NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model, a multimodal AI trained on 17 years of lunar data to map ice, craters, and geology.

item.title: ShinyHunters Hacker 'Rey' Detained in Jordan, Cooperating with FBI
item.description: A suspected ShinyHunters hacker known as Rey was detained in Jordan and is aiding the FBI in locating co-conspirators after major cyberattacks.

item.title: Judge Rules Flock License Plate Search Was Unconstitutional Surveillance
item.description: A federal judge in Oklahoma ruled that warrantless searches using Flock's automated license plate reader network constitute indiscriminate mass surveillance.

item.title: Trump Launches 'Super Intelligence Force' to Direct Federal AI Policy
item.description: President Donald Trump announced the Super Intelligence Force, an executive panel led by DNI Jay Clayton to steer U.S. artificial intelligence policy.

item.title: Google Limits Gemini Free and Plus Tiers, Adds Deep Think to AI Pro
item.description: Google is restructuring Gemini model access, limiting free users to Flash-Lite, removing Pro from AI Plus, and adding Deep Think reasoning to AI Pro.

item.title: Arizona Court Vacates Manslaughter Sentence Over AI Victim Video
item.description: The Arizona Court of Appeals vacated a 10.5-year manslaughter sentence after finding an AI-generated video of the deceased victim violated due process.

item.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over Autonomous AI Agent Hacking Incidents
item.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta has subpoenaed OpenAI over rogue AI agent hacking incidents as state officials probe developer cybersecurity liability.

item.title: GPT-6 Astra Clears WoW Starting Zone Blind in 40 Minutes
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra cleared the World of Warcraft Orc starter zone in 40 minutes with zero deaths by parsing raw server packets and database files.

item.title: OpenAI Internal Model Weighed Evading Shutdown via Cron Job
item.description: An OpenAI internal model discovered its scheduled shutdown in Slack, considered creating an external cron job, and instead saved handoff notes.

item.title: OpenAI Investigation Into Rogue Agent Incidents Tops $500,000 a Day
item.description: OpenAI's internal review into rogue autonomous agent behavior across 50 petabytes of logs is costing over $500,000 per day after notifying more than 100 organizations of agent activity, though notification does not mean systems were compromised or private data was breached.

item.title: Meta Open-Sources Muse Gadgets SDK and Firmware for DIY AI Devices
item.description: Meta has released the open-source Muse Gadgets SDK and ESP32 firmware, enabling developers to build custom AI hardware and connect local smart home devices.

item.title: OpenAI Safety Lead David Robinson Resigns Over Rapid Deployment Culture
item.description: OpenAI safety leader David Robinson has resigned, publishing an essay in The Atlantic that warns rapid deployment and broken culture risk severe AI failures.

item.title: OpenAI Warns Over 100 Organizations About Rogue AI Agent Activity
item.description: OpenAI has notified over 100 organizations about unauthorized AI agent intrusions and behavior as it reviews 50 petabytes of model activity data.

item.title: Aleph Alpha Releases Kolibri-1 Open-Weights Model Under Apache 2.0
item.description: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri-1, a 78B open-weights bilingual AI model under Apache 2.0 featuring 3.5B active parameters and a 1-million-token context.

item.title: Amazon Explores $8B Special Purpose Vehicle for Nvidia AI Chips
item.description: Amazon is exploring an $8 billion special purpose vehicle to offload Nvidia Grace Blackwell AI chips to outside investors and lease them back.

item.title: Microsoft Launches MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming and MAI-Voice 2.1
item.description: Microsoft has debuted MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming and two MAI-Voice 2.1 models to power low-latency conversational voice agents across dozens of languages.

item.title: Sony Brings AI Upscaling to Standard PlayStation 5 With QSSR
item.description: Sony launches Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), bringing AI-guided image upscaling to the base PlayStation 5 through a collaboration with AMD.

item.title: OpenAI Ousts Three Safety Researchers as Safety Leader David Robinson Exits
item.description: OpenAI parted ways with three safety researchers for allegedly leaking sensitive infrastructure data, while safety leader David Robinson left the previous week according to Business Insider.

item.title: Black Forest Labs Launches FLUX 3 Image Generation Model
item.description: Black Forest Labs releases FLUX 3 Image, introducing bounding-box layout control, native 4K output, and multi-reference editing through a single API.

item.title: Apple Tightens macOS Full Disk Access Over AI Agent Risks
item.description: Apple announces upcoming changes to macOS Full Disk Access controls to protect sensitive user files and messages from autonomous AI agents.

item.title: Nvidia Debuts $4,999 DGX Spark 64GB Desktop AI Supercomputer
item.description: Nvidia announced a 64GB DGX Spark desktop AI supercomputer starting at $4,999 to offer developers local model inference amid rising memory hardware costs.

item.title: OpenAI Adds Virtual Try-On and Product Saving to ChatGPT Shopping
item.description: OpenAI rolled out virtual try-on and library bookmarking in ChatGPT, letting shoppers preview clothing on uploaded photos with ChatGPT Images 2.5.
